abilities.name: Artistic Ingenuity
abilities.description: Uses Mehrak's mapping ability for offensive purposes, initiating a radial scan that deals AoE Dendro DMG. It will also scan all Dendro Cores in its AoE and cause them to immediately burst.

abilities.name: Painted Dome
_curatorNotes: Painted Dome grants Kaveh a 12s self-status (burstDuration = 720 frames): normal/charged/plunge attack AoE increased, DMG converted to Dendro, resistance to interruption increased. Status cancels immediately on swap (OnCharacterSwap handler in burst.go deletes burstKey). No spawned entity — behavior: 'instant' per recipe. duration: 12 left as generator artifact; reviewer to decide field placement.

Bloom/Lunar-Bloom damage bonus: while Painted Dome is active, all party members' Bloom reactions deal additional DMG (~27.5% at L1, scaling in burstDmgBonus[] in kaveh_gen.go). This team-wide buff is not represented in effects[]. Reviewer to author.
abilities.description:
Completely unleashes Mehrak's energy and creates a cubic scanned space, dealing AoE Dendro DMG to all opponents within it, causing all Dendro Cores in its AoE to immediately burst, and granting Kaveh the following enhanced combat abilities for a specific duration:
· Increases Kaveh's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack AoE, and converts his attack DMG to Dendro DMG that cannot be overridden.
· All Dendro Cores created by all your own party members through Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions will deal additional DMG when they burst.
· Increases Kaveh's resistance to interruption.
These effects will be canceled once Kaveh leaves the field.

passives.name: An Architect's Undertaking
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-09 model-mismatch cleanup: rewrote from `damage em 300 target:enemy` to `heal self em 300`. Trigger remains manual: gcsim a1() fires on onPlayerHit (Kaveh hit by a Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon-tagged attack), 0.5s ICD — no onPlayerHit + reaction-tag primitive yet; reviewer to wire.
passives.description: When DMG dealt by a Dendro Core (including DMG from Burgeon and Hyperbloom) hits Kaveh, Kaveh will regain HP equal to 300% of his Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

passives.name: A Craftsman's Curious Conceptions
_curatorNotes: Trigger: 'manual' — likely onHit (OnEnemyHit in asc.go a4AddStacksHandler) with conditions: ability in [normalAttack, chargedAttack, plungeAttack] (AttackTagNormal/Extra/Plunge), requires Painted Dome active (burstKey check). ICD: 0.1s (6 frames, a4ICDKey). Max 4 stacks of 25 EM each (a4Stacks capped at 4). Stack count resets on Q cast (c.a4Stacks = 0 in Burst()). Stat mod lasts for full Painted Dome window via modifier.NewBaseWithHitlag(a4Key, burstDuration = 720). Target scope: self. Reviewer to decide stack representation and condition authoring.
passives.description:
During Painted Dome, after Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, his Elemental Mastery will increase by 25. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 4 stacks.
This effect will be canceled when Painted Dome's effects end.

constellations.name: Pairidaeza's Dreams
_curatorNotes: Trigger: 'manual' — likely onHit (OnEnemyHit in cons.go c6()) with conditions: ability in [normalAttack, chargedAttack, plungeAttack] (AttackTagNormal/Extra/Plunge), requires Painted Dome active (burstKey). ICD: 3s (180 frames, c6ICDKey). Damage is AoE Dendro at hit enemy's position (AttackTagNone in gcsim). Also ruptures nearby Dendro Cores after delay (~18 frames, 0.3*60). Missing source: 'character' on effect skeleton. Reviewer to author trigger, ICD, and add source field.
constellations.description: When Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents during Painted Dome, they will unleash Pairidaeza's Light upon the opponent's position, dealing 61.8% of Kaveh's ATK as AoE Dendro DMG and causing all Dendro Cores within that AoE to burst. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
